stories.headline: Paraguay swears in Pedro Alliana as president
stories.summary: Paraguay's Senate removed President Santiago Peña from office after the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions of customers unable to reach their savings. Vice President Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president on 6 November. Ueno had been licensed as a bank only in 2023.

stories.headline: Belgium's king refuses his prime minister's resignation
stories.summary: Bart De Wever offered to resign as prime minister of Belgium as negotiations over the country's budget stalled. King Philippe refused the resignation and told him to continue with the budget talks. De Wever has held the office since February 2025.

stories.headline: Mexico passes a law on digital payments
stories.summary: Mexico has approved a law called the Digital Economy Act for Digital and Electronic Payments. It allows the government to designate sectors in which digital payments are the only accepted means of payment.

stories.headline: Dinosaur blood survives in 115-million-year-old bones
stories.summary: An international team led by Curtin University has found fossilised red blood cells, and chemical evidence of blood molecules, in the bones of a meat-eating dinosaur called Aratasaurus museunacionali. The remains are about 115 million years old. The analysis found heme molecules, which are components of the protein that lets red blood cells carry oxygen.
